description: Datadog monitors for the Trust & Safety architecture. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [T&S] High volume of pending reports
[T&S] Report submission spike
[T&S] No moderation activity for 30 minutes
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No moderation actions (approve/reject) have been recorded in the last 30 minutes. This may indicate the moderation team is unavailable or the moderation pipeline is broken.

**Actions:**
1. Verify the moderation UI is operational.
2. Check if the moderation API endpoints are healthy.
3. Contact the on-call moderation team.
4. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [T&S] Block rate anomaly
[T&S] Dating risk score threshold exceeded
[T&S] Moderation queue latency spike
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The average moderation action latency has exceeded 5 seconds over the last 10 minutes. This may indicate Supabase query slowdown, connection pool exhaustion, or infrastructure issues.

**Current value:** {{value}}s
**Threshold:** 5s

**Actions:**
1. Check Supabase / PostgreSQL query performance.
2. Inspect the reports and blocks tables for missing indexes.
3. Check for rate limiting or connection pool exhaustion.
{{/is_alert}}
